reason: Verified in source and in the driven page. b.css declares a measure on exactly three prose blocks - .b-emptyBody 34ch (l.530), .b-endedBody 40ch (l.679), .b-pressBody 46ch (l.549) - and declares none on .b-behindNote (l.286), .b-note (l.567) or .b-gapNote (l.100); text-wrap: pretty is a wrap-quality hint, not a measure. Measured at 1280 and 1440: .b-behindNote box is 644px in owner-flight and 642px on desk, .b-note box is 684px on publish carrying an 85-character line at 13px - the longest measure and the smallest type on the same screen, and well past the 45-75 character band the rest of the file honours. One zero-glyph in Geist at 15px is 9.95px, so the 644px behind-you column is 64.7ch of capacity holding a 64-character sentence: it survives on one line by a single character, and .b-behindNote is generated from real counts and dates ('2 done, the last of them 18 April') so it grows with the data. Neither gate covers this: audit.mjs has no measure or max-width check and interaction-check.mjs's 'measure' assertions are about the timeline rail's proportional spacing, not line length. lessons.md l.53 is the card floor/ceiling class, not this one. Not taste stated as a defect - the argument is the file's own declared convention applied to three paragraphs and skipped on the two that carry the most meaning. One factual slip in the write-up, immaterial to the defect: the owner-flight string is 64 characters, not 76; 76 is the desk string. Both quoted pixel widths are exact.
sharpenedFix: Take the fix as written - max-width: 46ch on .b-behindNote, 52ch on .b-note, 46ch on .b-gapNote in b.css - it aims at the right file and I simulated it in the live page: 46ch resolves to 457px and 52ch to 448px, nothing else moves, owner-flight's behind-you line stays one line, and the desk behind-you line and the publish revocation note each fall to two balanced lines. Two things to know before applying. (1) .b-note has two instances in render-b.js - the publish note at l.682 and the ended note at l.756; the ended one already renders inside the 300px .b-bubble, so the cap is a no-op there and only the publish note changes, which is the intent. (2) Put the caps beside the existing 34ch/40ch/46ch declarations, not in a new block, so the measure ladder reads as one decision in one place.
